description: Redesign the workspace-shell.tsx (sidebar with grouped nav + user section at bottom, topbar at 56px without theme toggle, Overview with inline stats and no live dot, MeetingsView with grouped list replacing card grid, ActionItemsView with filter tabs) and the auth pages (login, register — improved centered card layout).
steps: 1. Read components/signalroom/workspace-shell.tsx in full. Read app/login/page.tsx and app/register/page.tsx.

a. Replace the flat `navigation` array with a grouped structure. Define a `NAV_GROUPS` constant of type `{ label: string | null; items: { label: ViewName; icon: typeof Grid2X2 }[] }[]`. Groups: [{label: null, items: [{label:'Overview', icon:Grid2X2}, {label:'Meetings', icon:CalendarDays}, {label:'Action Items', icon:Check}]}, {label:'Tools', items:[{label:'Analytics', icon:BarChart3}]}, {label:'Manage', items:[{label:'Calendar', icon:CalendarDays}, {label:'Team', icon:UsersRound}, {label:'Archive', icon:Archive}]}, {label:'Account', items:[{label:'Settings', icon:Settings2}]}]. NOTE: Remove 'Search' from the sidebar nav groups — it is triggered only by keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+K) and the topbar button. The ViewName type, viewSlugs, and slugViews maps must NOT change — they are used for URL routing and 'Search' must remain in slugViews for backward compat.

b. Rewrite the Sidebar component: iterate NAV_GROUPS. For each group, if group.label is non-null render a `<span className='nav-label nav-group-label'>` with the label text. For each item render a `<button className={\`nav-item ${active === label ? 'nav-active' : ''}\`}`. Sidebar bottom section (sidebar-bottom div): render ThemeToggle + user initials avatar + user name. The bottom section is inside the Sidebar component so it needs userName and userInitials props — add these two props to the Sidebar component's prop types. Pass them from AppShell. Width is now controlled by CSS (220px via --sidebar-width) so no width prop needed.
c. Update the Topbar component: remove ThemeToggle from the top-actions div. The topbar is now search trigger + bell + avatar only. Height is controlled by CSS.

d. Update the Overview component's hero-row: Remove the `<span className='live-dot' />` element and the 'System nominal' text from the hero-eyebrow div. Keep the date range label. Keep the greeting h1. Change the stats section: replace `.stats-grid` div with `.stats-row` div containing 4 `.stat-inline` items. Each stat-inline item shows label (eyebrow), value (larger text), and detail (muted). This is a cosmetic change — no data/logic change.

e. Rewrite the MeetingsView component: Group meetings by time period. Define a helper function `groupMeetingsByPeriod(meetings: Meeting[])` that returns `{ label: string; meetings: Meeting[] }[]` with groups: 'This week' (meetings where date is within the current ISO week), 'Last week' (previous ISO week), 'Older' (everything else). For each group render a `.meeting-group` div with a `.meeting-group-label` span and then `.meeting-row` buttons for each meeting. Each row uses a button (existing onClick calls onSelect). Row layout: date | title | status badge | duration | participants count | chevron icon. Use `<span className={\`status meeting-status ${getMeetingStatusTone(m.status)}\`}>` for status — preserving the programmatic class. Keep the EmptyState fallback unchanged.

f. Rewrite the ActionItemsView component: Add local state `const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'open' | 'in-progress' | 'done' | 'overdue'>('all')`. Add filter tabs row (`.action-filter-tabs`) with buttons: All / Open / In progress / Done / Overdue. Filter logic: 'open' = status Pending, 'in-progress' = status 'In progress', 'done' = status Done, 'overdue' = dueDate < today AND status !== Done. Apply filter to data.actionItems before rendering. Each task-row: add `border-left: 2px solid var(--coral)` inline style OR a class when item is overdue — use a CSS class `.task-overdue` (add to globals.css in FEAT-001 step 2). All existing task-row structure, task-check, task-done classes remain unchanged.
g. Update AppShell to pass userName and userInitials to Sidebar.

3. Modify app/login/page.tsx: Keep ALL logic (state, handleSubmit, router, apiFetch calls) unchanged. Change the JSX structure: add an `<div className='auth-panel-header'>` section above the form containing the brand mark, h1, and p. Add `<div className='auth-panel-body'>` around the form. These are CSS class additions — add the classes to globals.css in FEAT-001 if not already there, or handle via existing classes. The overall structure remains auth-shell > auth-panel > (brand + h1 + p + form + links).
4. Modify app/register/page.tsx: Same approach as login — keep all logic, improve JSX structure with auth-panel-header and auth-panel-body classes.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar renders 8 nav items (Overview, Meetings, Action Items, Analytics, Calendar, Team, Archive, Settings) in 4 groups with visible section labels for Tools, Manage, Account
Search is NOT in the sidebar nav groups — it is still accessible via Ctrl+K and topbar button
Active nav item shows left border accent (border-left: 2px solid var(--amber)) via nav-active class
Sidebar bottom shows ThemeToggle + user initials avatar + user name
Topbar is 56px tall with no ThemeToggle (moved to sidebar)
Overview hero-eyebrow has NO live-dot span and NO 'System nominal' text
Overview shows 4 inline stats in a flex row (stats-row class) instead of the old 4-card stats-grid
MeetingsView renders a grouped list with time period labels ('This week', 'Last week', 'Older') not a 3-col card grid
ActionItemsView has filter tabs: All / Open / In progress / Done / Overdue
Overdue action items have a colored left border (task-overdue class or inline style)
Login and register pages render with the updated auth-panel styling
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit exits 0 — all types are correct (NAV_GROUPS uses ViewName type correctly)
verification: Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` from e:\Final_Year_Project — must exit 0
Run `pnpm build` from e:\Final_Year_Project — must exit 0
findings: All component and CSS changes implemented successfully. `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` exits 0 — all types correct. `pnpm build` fails with EPERM errors (permission denied on .env and .next/trace files) — this is the same sandbox/OS restriction documented in FEAT-001 findings; it is not a code error. Git commit could not be made due to the same sandbox restriction denying access to the .git directory. All acceptance criteria are met: NAV_GROUPS with 4 groups (8 nav items), Search excluded from sidebar nav but preserved in ViewName type and viewSlugs/slugViews maps, ThemeToggle moved to sidebar-bottom with user avatar + name, ThemeToggle removed from Topbar, live-dot and 'System nominal' removed from Overview hero-eyebrow, stats-row with 4 stat-inline items replaces stats-grid, MeetingsView grouped by time period with meeting-row buttons, ActionItemsView with filter tabs and task-overdue CSS class, auth pages updated with auth-panel-header and auth-panel-body classes, .task-overdue and .auth-panel-header/.auth-panel-body added to globals.css.
